description: Design the structural anatomy of screens at wireframe fidelity — what goes where and why, before anyone argues about how it looks. Part of the Intent design strategy system. Produces lo-fi idea boards for divergent exploration, complete interactive grayscale wireframes with real labels and real hierarchy, and click-through prototypes that materialize flow logic from /journey. Trigger on: wireframe, wireframes, wireframing, thumbnails, "sketch the screen", "lay out this page", "what goes where on this screen", screen layout, page structure, lo-fi, mid-fi, click-through prototype, wireflow, "wireframe the dashboard", or any request to design the structure of a screen before its visual design. The flow through screens belongs to /journey; the information structure belongs to /organize; the words belong to /articulate — this skill owns the screen itself.
